title: Lowercase g exploration
slide_intent: Compare alternatives for a conspicuous letter because a small change can alter both readability and personality.
strategic_value: Exploring the g can help Duolingo choose a memorable feature without making the full wordmark inconsistent.
demonstration: Twelve green lowercase g variants form two rows, comparing loop structures, terminals and proportions.
practical_value: Compare competing constructions side by side before selecting a distinctive letter.

content_islands.name: Upper alternatives
content_islands.spec: Align six looped g variants in the upper row.

content_islands.name: Lower alternatives
content_islands.spec: Place six further constructions beneath, keeping their shared green and scale comparable.

reference_purposes.Intent: Johnson Banks describes extensive discussion of the lowercase g and says the more memorable looped form won through.
reference_purposes.Expression: The repeated green alternatives make differences in bowl, loop and terminal visible.
